messages:
amanda: Quick sync — Monday KPI review. dashboard shows MQLs down ~18% after last week's launch posts and webinar push. did we change any inbound routing rules? :thinking_face:
ryan: Not intentionally. I noticed a spike in 'unknown' campaign source in the hubspot logs around 03:20 UTC Sat — might be UTM parsing.
linh: @ryan can you paste the raw lines? i can check the routing map.
ryan: sure, here's the gist: `SELECT source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at > '2026-03-14' GROUP BY source;` results: organic: 210, paid: 134, unknown: 72 (normal is ~10).
kate: that unknown count matches the jump in webinar signups too. some registrants came via the launch post thread link. maybe we botched the utm on the shortlink.
noah: i pulled the launch post draft — the shortlink we used was missing the `utm_campaign` param for the webinar batch. lame.
amanda: okay that's probably the root cause for attribution mismatches. two asks: 1) can we patch the shortlink and repost a correction? 2) can ops reassign the 'unknown' leads to the webinar campaign so weekly KPI is accurate for reporting?
linh: i can run a backfill script to remap leads where referer contains `t.co` or `lnkd` and landing page = /webinar to campaign = "webinar_q1_launch". would that be acceptable?
ryan: yes. but note: some leads have already been routed to the SDR queue based on 'unknown' routing rule — reassigning campaign won't change owner. is that okay?
kate: we should keep owners as-is to avoid churn. ops can add a campaign tag + annotation so analytics count includes them but SDRs keep the leads.
noah: +1. also recommend adding a short validation step in the launch checklist to verify UTM on final published shortlinks. saved us before. :memo:
amanda: good. for the weekly KPI deck — should we treat these remapped leads as part of the webinar cohort or separate? i'm leaning to include them but add a footnote explaining retro attribution correction.
linh: include them in the deck but show pre/post remap numbers. i'll generate both tables.
ore: growth-bot: automated note: 72 leads flagged for manual remap. run `/growth remap 1768456789` to start the job.
amanda: ha, nice. @growth-bot pls proceed when linh confirms SQL.
linh: running local validation now. will push safe update if no anomalies.
ryan: side note — our dashboard is last-click heavy. product asked if we can show multi-touch snapshots for launch-only cohorts to reduce noise from routing gaps.
kate: yes, we should show 'first touch' and 'time-to-convert' columns for webinars. that will help tell the narrative for the post-launch drop (mostly attribution, not real performance).
amanda: agree. action items: lin h — run remap & produce pre/post tables (ETA EOD). ryan — add quick fix to shortlink template and checklist. kate — update KPI deck slides to include multi-touch snapshot + footnote. noah — add checklist item for shortlink QA to launch playbook. i'll own comms to sales to explain the correction.
noah: noted, will add to playbook and ping legal for any note required for prospect contact.
linh: remap done on staging — 70/72 matched patterns, 2 flagged for manual review (bad referer). pushing to prod after 10m smoke.
amanda: amazing. once prod is done, can you post the before/after numbers in #marketing for the weekly review?
linh: will do.
amanda: thanks all. this was a quick attribution scare but good catch. we'll reflect it in Monday's KPI review and mark as "attribution correction" in the deck. :white_check_mark:
ryan: quick FYI — also added a Grafana panel showing 'unknown' source trend so we can catch this earlier. link: https://grafana.redwood/g/abc123/unknown-source-trend
kate: perfect. that plus the checklist should avoid repeats.
noah: closing loop: SDRs informed? amanda: sending a short note now.
amanda: sent — cc'd @sales-team. end.
